::: {.content-section}
## Experience

::: {.cv-entry}
::: {.cv-when}
Sep 2020 — Sep 2025
:::
::: {.cv-what}
### Postdoctoral Associate

**Massachusetts Institute of Technology** · Cambridge, MA

- Led molecular-dynamics and machine-learning studies of interfacial electrostatics.
- Designed and implemented GPU-accelerated Bayesian inference models that revealed previously undetected patterns in single-atom interfacial electric-field data.
- Developed high-performance, GPU-accelerated Julia implementations of Ewald summation and related electrostatics methods.
- Performed free-energy perturbation and thermodynamic-integration calculations for electron-transfer reactions at nanoparticle and electrode interfaces.
- Built end-to-end simulation and analytics pipelines that cut compute time two- to fivefold across coarse-grained polymers, polarizable nanoparticles, and interfacial electric-field systems.
- Standardized reproducible pipelines (Pixi, Docker, CI) that were adopted across projects.
- Recognized by the chemistry department for mentoring graduate and undergraduate students in research.
:::
:::

::: {.cv-entry}
::: {.cv-when}
Sep 2014 — Aug 2020
:::
::: {.cv-what}
### Graduate Student Researcher

**University of Maine** · Orono, ME

- Generated and analyzed ~100 TB of molecular-dynamics data to understand how water-mediated interactions govern helix–coil transitions of peptides confined in carbon nanotubes.
- Developed kinetic models of ligand-mediated nanocluster formation and growth.
:::
:::
